tabs.title: warrior
displayed_texts: warrior
The Warrior starts with a _unique broken seal_ that grants him a burst of shielding when he is below half health. The seal can be moved between armors, and can _transfer a single upgrade_ with it.
The Warrior also starts with a _worn shortsword_, _three throwing stones_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Warrior automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Healing
_-_ Scrolls of Rage

tabs.title: Talents
displayed_texts: Talents
The hero gains one talent point each time they level up. Higher tier talents appear after defeating the second boss.
Reach level 6 to unlock more talents.
tier 1

tabs.title: Subclasses
displayed_texts: subclasses
A subclass can be chosen after defeating the second boss.
The _Berserker_ builds rage as he takes damage. Rage increases his damage and can be activated at 100% for bonus shielding.
The _Gladiator_ builds combo when he makes successful attacks. He can spend combo to use unique abilities.

tabs.title: Armor Abilities
displayed_texts: armor abilities
An armor ability can be chosen after defeating the fourth boss.
The Warrior performs a _Heroic Leap_ towards a targeted location, sailing above enemies and hazards.
The Warrior releases a _Shockwave_ in a conical AOE by slamming the ground. Enemies caught in the shockwave are damaged and crippled.
The Warrior _Endures_, skipping several turns but gaining high damage resistance. He then deals bonus damage based on what he endured.

tabs.title: mage
displayed_texts: mage
The Mage starts with a _unique staff_, which recharges significantly faster than a wand and has 1 more charge. The staff _can be imbued with any wand_ the Mage finds in the dungeon.
The Mage also starts with a _wand of magic missile_ imbued in his staff, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Mage automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Liquid Flame
_-_ Scrolls of Upgrade

displayed_texts: Talents

tabs.title: Subclasses
displayed_texts: subclasses
A subclass can be chosen after defeating the second boss.
The _Battlemage_ conjures bonus effects when fighting in melee with his staff. These effects depend on the wand his staff is imbued with.
The _Warlock_ has a chance to soul mark enemies with his wands. He will heal whenever he deals physical damage to marked enemies.

tabs.title: Armor Abilities
displayed_texts: armor abilities
An armor ability can be chosen after defeating the fourth boss.
The Mage emits an _Elemental Blast_ from his staff, covering a large area around him in an effect that varies based on the wand in his staff.
The Mage unleashes the _Wild Magic_ contained in his wands, randomly firing them multiple times at a chosen target over a single turn.
The Mage places a _Warping Beacon_ at his current location, which he can instantly teleport back to.

tabs.title: rogue
displayed_texts: rogue
The Rogue starts with a _unique Cloak of Shadows_, which he can use to become invisible at will.
The Rogue can _detect secrets and traps_ from a greater distance.
The Rogue also starts with _a dagger_, _three throwing knives_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Rogue automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Invisibility
_-_ Scrolls of Magic Mapping

tabs.title: Subclasses
displayed_texts: subclasses
A subclass can be chosen after defeating the second boss.
The _Assassin_ can prepare a deadly strike while he is invisible. The longer he waits, the more powerful the attack will be.
The _Freerunner_ builds momentum as he runs, which can be used to start freerunning. This grants him bonus speed and evasion for a short while.

tabs.title: Armor Abilities
displayed_texts: armor abilities
An armor ability can be chosen after defeating the fourth boss.
The Rogue throws down a _Smoke Bomb_ while blinking away. He blinds enemies near his old location.
The Rogue places a _Death Mark_ on a chosen enemy. Marked enemies take bonus damage, but cannot die until the mark ends.
The Rogue summons a _Shadow Clone_, which can be directed to aid him in combat.

tabs.title: huntress
displayed_texts: huntress
The Huntress starts with a _unique spirit bow_, which can fire an infinite number of conjured arrows.
The Huntress can travel through tall grass _without trampling it_.
The Huntress also starts with _studded gloves_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Huntress automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Mind Vision
_-_ Scrolls of Lullaby

tabs.title: Subclasses
displayed_texts: subclasses
A subclass can be chosen after defeating the second boss.
The _Sniper_ can pierce armor with her ranged attacks. After striking with a thrown weapon she can follow up with a special attack from her bow.
The _Warden_ can see through tall grass and gains bonus effects when she plants seeds and tramples plants.

tabs.title: Armor Abilities
displayed_texts: armor abilities
An armor ability can be chosen after defeating the fourth boss.
The Huntress throws _Spectral Blades_ at a target, inflicting damage depending on her currently equipped melee weapon.
The Huntress calls upon _Nature's Power_, increasing her movement speed and her bow's rate of fire for a short time.
The Huntress summons a _Spirit Hawk_ familiar, which can help her scout locations and distract enemies.

tabs.title: duelist
displayed_texts: duelist
The Duelist starts with a _unique rapier_ with a special ability that recharges over time.
Every weapon in the game has a _different special ability_ that the Duelist can use.
The Duelist also starts with _two throwing spikes_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Duelist automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Strength
_-_ Scrolls of Mirror Image

displayed_texts: Talents

tabs.title: Subclasses
displayed_texts: subclasses
A subclass can be chosen after defeating the second boss.
The _Champion_ can wield two weapons and gets more weapon charges. Her regular attacks use her primary weapon, but she can swap weapons and use either weapon's ability.
The _Monk_ builds energy while fighting. This energy can be spent on a variety of unique abilities.

tabs.title: Armor Abilities
displayed_texts: armor abilities
An armor ability can be chosen after defeating the fourth boss.
The Duelist _Challenges_ a nearby enemy to a duel, temporarily freezing all other enemies.
The Duelist performs an _Elemental Strike_, spreading an effect in a conical AOE based on her weapon enchantment.
The Duelist _Feints_, faking an attack while dashing to an adjacent tile. Enemies will attack her afterimage, leaving them open to a counterattack.

tabs.title: cleric
displayed_texts: cleric
The Cleric starts with a _unique holy tome_, which they can use to cast various spells.
Most of the Cleric's talents are focused around learning or upgrading spells.
The Cleric also starts with _a cudgel_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Cleric automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Purity
_-_ Scrolls of Remove Curse

tabs.title: Subclasses
displayed_texts: subclasses
A subclass can be chosen after defeating the second boss.
The _Priest_ gains new long-range spells and an empowered version of guiding light.
The _Paladin_ gains new short-range spells and empowered versions of holy weapon and ward.

tabs.title: Armor Abilities
displayed_texts: armor abilities
An armor ability can be chosen after defeating the fourth boss.
The Cleric assumes an _Ascended Form_, gaining new spells, attack range, and shielding.
The Cleric gains a _Trinity_ of abilities, which emulate equipment they have seen and can be assigned by using new spells.
The Cleric channels the _Power of Many_, empowering an existing ally or creating a new one.
